description:
Define-XML conformance validator implementing the CDISC Define-XML
        v2.1 Conformance Rules and the PMDA Validation Rules v6.0 Define-XML
        sheet against the cumba-oss-cdisc-define object model. Java only — no
        Python parity.

        LIBRARY ONLY: this module ships no CLI, matching cumba-oss-corej-core.
        It is consumed as a library; the Define-XML conformance rule corpus it
        evaluates is distributed separately from this artifact.
